spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('hardener', Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'harden-installer.py')
hardener = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(hardener)


class Hardener(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_maintainer_signature_is_required_even_with_valid_tag_attestation(self):
        block = hardener.REPLACEMENTS[0][1]
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            archive = root / 'archive'
            archive.write_bytes(b'archive fixture')
            inventory = {'schema': 1, 'repository': 'marcinwadon/hennery', 'tag': 'v1.2.3', 'artifacts': [{'name': 'hennery-test.tar.xz', 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}]}
            raw = json.dumps(inventory).encode()
            (root / 'inventory').write_bytes(raw)
            (root / 'signature').write_bytes(raw)
            (root / 'bundle').write_text('valid-looking exact-tag attestation')
            tools = root / 'tools'
            tools.mkdir()
            (tools / 'gh').write_text('#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n')
            (tools / 'gpg').write_text('''#!/bin/sh
for arg in "$@"; do
    if [ "$arg" = --import ]; then
        printf called > "$TEST_ROOT/gpg-import-called"
        [ "$HENNERY_TEST_SIGNATURE" != import-failed ] || exit 1
        exit 0
    fi
done
printf called > "$TEST_ROOT/gpg-called"
case "$HENNERY_TEST_SIGNATURE" in
  unsigned|malformed) exit 1 ;;
  wrong-key) echo '[GNUPG:] VALIDSIG 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'; exit 0 ;;
  revoked) echo '[GNUPG:] REVKEYSIG bad'; echo '[GNUPG:] VALIDSIG F26C7F594DFE84D131703AFC23E5A318AE8D2861'; exit 0 ;;
  failed-valid) echo '[GNUPG:] VALIDSIG F26C7F594DFE84D131703AFC23E5A318AE8D2861'; exit 1 ;;
  expired) echo '[GNUPG:] KEYEXPIRED 123'; echo '[GNUPG:] VALIDSIG F26C7F594DFE84D131703AFC23E5A318AE8D2861'; exit 0 ;;
  no-status) exit 0 ;;
  duplicate) echo '[GNUPG:] VALIDSIG F26C7F594DFE84D131703AFC23E5A318AE8D2861' ;;
esac
cmp "$HENNERY_RELEASE_SIGNATURE" "$HENNERY_RELEASE_INVENTORY" || exit 1
echo '[GNUPG:] VALIDSIG F26C7F594DFE84D131703AFC23E5A318AE8D2861'
''')
            for tool in tools.iterdir():
                tool.chmod(0o755)
            script = root / 'check.sh'
            script.write_text('''#!/bin/sh
set -eu
check_cmd() {
case "$HENNERY_TEST_SIGNATURE:$1" in missing-gpg:gpg|missing-jq:jq) return 1 ;; esac
command -v "$1" >/dev/null
}
err() { echo "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
run() {
local _dir="$TEST_ROOT/$HENNERY_TEST_SIGNATURE" _file="$TEST_ROOT/archive" _artifact_name=hennery-test.tar.xz
APP_VERSION=1.2.3
''' + block + '\nprintf authenticated > "$TEST_ROOT/authenticated"\n}\n# Conditional callers suppress errexit inside functions; refusal must be explicit.\nif run; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi\n')
            env = dict(os.environ, PATH=str(tools) + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'], TEST_ROOT=str(root),
                       HENNERY_ATTESTATION_BUNDLE=str(root / 'bundle'), HENNERY_RELEASE_INVENTORY=str(root / 'inventory'),
                       HENNERY_RELEASE_SIGNATURE=str(root / 'signature'))
            for case in ['valid', 'unsigned', 'malformed', 'wrong-key', 'revoked', 'expired', 'duplicate', 'no-status', 'failed-valid', 'import-failed', 'different-inventory', 'missing', 'empty-signature', 'missing-inventory', 'wrong-archive', 'wrong-tag', 'duplicate-archive', 'missing-gpg', 'missing-jq', 'wrong-repository', 'wrong-schema']:
                with self.subTest(case=case):
                    (root / case).mkdir()
                    (root / 'inventory').write_bytes(raw)
                    (root / 'signature').write_bytes(raw)
                    (root / 'authenticated').unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    (root / 'gpg-called').unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    (root / 'gpg-import-called').unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    if case == 'different-inventory':
                        (root / 'inventory').write_bytes(raw + b' ')
                    elif case == 'missing':
                        (root / 'signature').unlink()
                    elif case == 'missing-inventory':
                        (root / 'inventory').unlink()
                    elif case == 'empty-signature':
                        (root / 'signature').write_bytes(b'')
                    elif case in ('wrong-archive', 'wrong-tag', 'duplicate-archive', 'wrong-repository', 'wrong-schema'):
                        changed = json.loads(raw)
                        if case == 'wrong-archive':
                            changed['artifacts'][0]['sha256'] = '0' * 64
                        elif case == 'wrong-tag':
                            changed['tag'] = 'v9.9.9'
                        elif case == 'wrong-repository':
                            changed['repository'] = 'another/repository'
                        elif case == 'wrong-schema':
                            changed['schema'] = 2
                        else:
                            changed['artifacts'].append(changed['artifacts'][0].copy())
                        data = json.dumps(changed).encode()
                        (root / 'inventory').write_bytes(data)
                        (root / 'signature').write_bytes(data)
                    result = subprocess.run(['sh', str(script)], env=dict(env, HENNERY_TEST_SIGNATURE=case), capture_output=True, text=True)
                    if case == 'valid':
                        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
                        self.assertTrue((root / 'authenticated').exists())
                    else:
                        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0, 'valid-looking tag attestation bypassed ' + case)
                        self.assertFalse((root / 'authenticated').exists())
                        if case == 'import-failed':
                            self.assertTrue((root / 'gpg-import-called').exists(), 'the import must actually be attempted')
                            self.assertFalse((root / 'gpg-called').exists(), 'failed import must refuse before signature verification')
                        if case in ('missing', 'empty-signature', 'missing-inventory'):
                            self.assertFalse((root / 'gpg-called').exists(), 'missing input must be refused before invoking gpg')

    def test_signature_identity_is_exact_tag_and_verification_precedes_extraction(self):
        result = hardener.harden('\n'.join(old for old, _ in hardener.REPLACEMENTS))
        self.assertIn('--cert-identity "https://github.com/marcinwadon/hennery/.github/workflows/release-publish.yml@refs/tags/v$APP_VERSION"', result)
        self.assertIn('--source-ref "refs/tags/v$APP_VERSION"', result)
        self.assertIn('refusing an archive without valid release-tag provenance', result)

    def test_all_anchors_are_required_once(self):
        pristine = '\n'.join(old for old, _ in hardener.REPLACEMENTS)
        result = hardener.harden(pristine)
        self.assertIn('ln "$_stage/$_bin_name" "$_install_dir/"', result)
        self.assertIn('[ "${#_checksum_value}" = 64 ]', result)
        for old, _ in hardener.REPLACEMENTS:
            with self.subTest(anchor=old[:60]):
                with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
                    hardener.harden(pristine.replace(old, '', 1))
                with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
                    hardener.harden(pristine + '\n' + old)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

import gate

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


class InstallerArchives(unittest.TestCase):
    def candidate(self, root, *, missing=False, extra=False):
        name = 'hennery-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.xz'
        data = b'archive fixture'
        if not missing:
            (root / name).write_bytes(data)
        (root / (name + '.sha256')).write_text(gate.digest(data) + '  ' + name + '\n')
        (root / 'hennery-installer.sh').write_text(
            '#!/bin/sh\ncase "$unused" in\n"' + name + '")\n'
            '    _checksum_style="sha256"\n'
            '    _checksum_value="' + gate.digest(data) + '"\n'
            '    ;;\nesac\nexit 99\n')
        if extra:
            (root / 'hennery-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.xz').write_bytes(data)
        return name

    def check(self, root):
        return subprocess.run(['sh', str(ROOT / 'packaging/test-installer.sh'), str(root)],
                              capture_output=True, text=True)

    def test_offered_executable_archive_must_exist_even_with_sidecar(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            name = self.candidate(root, missing=True)
            result = self.check(root)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1, result.stdout + result.stderr)
            self.assertIn('this build has no ' + name + '\n', result.stderr)

    def test_executable_archive_must_be_offered(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            self.candidate(root, extra=True)
            result = self.check(root)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1, result.stdout + result.stderr)
            self.assertIn('the installer does not offer hennery-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.xz', result.stderr)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

"""Exercise restricted installer tool directories, including merged /usr bins."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


class InstallerTools(unittest.TestCase):
    def fixture(self, root, *, conflicting=False, missing_gh=False):
        source = (ROOT / 'packaging/test-installer.sh').read_text()
        functions = source[source.index('# tools <dir>'):source.index('# copy <name>')]
        self.assertEqual(functions.count('for from in /usr/bin /bin; do'), 1)
        functions = functions.replace('for from in /usr/bin /bin; do',
                                      'for from in "$scratch/first" "$scratch/second"; do')
        for name in ('first', 'second', 'verifier-tools'):
            (root / name).mkdir()
        for name in ('system-gpg', 'other-gpg', 'system-jq'):
            (root / name).write_text(name + '\n')
        for directory in ('first', 'second'):
            target = 'other-gpg' if conflicting and directory == 'second' else 'system-gpg'
            (root / directory / 'gpg').symlink_to(root / target)
            (root / directory / 'jq').symlink_to(root / 'system-jq')
            (root / directory / 'gh').symlink_to(root / 'system-gpg')
        for name in ('gpg', 'jq'):
            (root / 'verifier-tools' / name).write_text('offline ' + name + '\n')
        if missing_gh:
            start = source.index('tools "$scratch/no-gh-tools"')
            setup = source[start:source.index('(PATH="$scratch/no-gh-tools"', start)]
        else:
            setup = 'tools "$scratch/no-gh-tools" gh\n'
        script = 'set -eu\nfail() { printf "%s\\n" "$*" >&2; exit 1; }\n'
        script += 'scratch=$1\n' + functions + setup + 'printf ready > "$scratch/ready"\n'
        return subprocess.run(['sh', '-c', script, 'installer-tools', str(root)],
                              capture_output=True, text=True)

    def test_missing_gh_setup_reserves_the_offline_signer_when_system_gpg_exists(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            result = self.fixture(root, missing_gh=True)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
            self.assertTrue((root / 'ready').exists())
            for name in ('gpg', 'jq'):
                self.assertTrue((root / 'no-gh-tools' / name).samefile(root / 'verifier-tools' / name))
            self.assertFalse((root / 'no-gh-tools' / 'gh').exists())

    def test_duplicate_tool_names_resolving_to_the_same_binary_are_accepted(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            result = self.fixture(root)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
            self.assertTrue((root / 'ready').exists())
            self.assertTrue((root / 'no-gh-tools' / 'gpg').is_symlink())
            self.assertTrue((root / 'no-gh-tools' / 'gpg').samefile(root / 'system-gpg'))

    def test_duplicate_tool_names_with_different_binaries_refuse_without_replacement(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp)
            result = self.fixture(root, conflicting=True)
            self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0, 'conflicting binary was silently accepted')
            self.assertFalse((root / 'ready').exists())
            self.assertTrue((root / 'no-gh-tools' / 'gpg').samefile(root / 'system-gpg'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

````sh
#!/bin/sh
# The hardened shell installer (distribution spec §2, §9), run against the
# archives of this build, served from a directory (`file://`):
#   - each executable archive is offered, with its SHA-256 embedded;
#     application and third-party source bundles are separate release assets;
#   - it installs a binary that runs, with `sha256sum` or with `shasum`;
#   - a checksum mismatch aborts, and installs nothing;
#   - no SHA-256 tool, an empty checksum, no checksum at all, or a checksum
#     style it does not know aborts, and installs nothing.
# HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME point into a scratch directory, so nothing outside
# it is written.
#
# Usage: test-installer.sh <directory holding hennery-installer.sh and every
# archive with its .sha256>
set -eu
# Either would install outside the scratch directory and make the "left a
# binary" checks vacuous.
unset HENNERY_INSTALL_DIR CARGO_DIST_FORCE_INSTALL_DIR

dist=$(cd "$1" && pwd)
installer="$dist/hennery-installer.sh"
scratch=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$scratch"' EXIT

# The candidate has not been signed yet. This offline verifier double checks
# every real CLI identity argument; public installation uses the real gh CLI.
fixture_version=$(sed -n 's/^APP_VERSION="\([^"]*\)"$/\1/p' "$installer")
mkdir "$scratch/verifier-tools"
printf 'offline verification fixture\n' > "$scratch/bundle.jsonl"
cat > "$scratch/verifier-tools/gh" <<TOOL
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
[ "\$1" = attestation ] && [ "\$2" = verify ] || exit 1
shift 3
identity=0
source=0
while [ "\$#" -gt 0 ]; do
    case "\$1" in
        --cert-identity)
            [ "\$2" = "https://github.com/marcinwadon/hennery/.github/workflows/release-publish.yml@\${HENNERY_TEST_SIGNER_REF:-refs/tags/v$fixture_version}" ] || exit 1
            identity=1; shift 2 ;;
        --source-ref)
            [ "\$2" = 'refs/tags/v$fixture_version' ] || exit 1
            source=1; shift 2 ;;
        *) shift ;;
    esac
done
[ "\$identity" = 1 ] && [ "\$source" = 1 ] || exit 1
printf verified > '$scratch/signature-verified'
TOOL
chmod +x "$scratch/verifier-tools/gh"
# No real signing operation occurs in this offline acceptance test. The gpg
# double models a detached signature over exact bytes and pinned signer status.
cat > "$scratch/verifier-tools/gpg" <<'TOOL'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
for argument in "$@"; do [ "$argument" != --import ] || exit 0; done
case "${HENNERY_TEST_MAINTAINER_SIGNATURE:-valid}" in
    unsigned|malformed) exit 1 ;;
    wrong-key) echo '[GNUPG:] VALIDSIG 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'; exit 0 ;;
esac
cmp "$HENNERY_RELEASE_SIGNATURE" "$HENNERY_RELEASE_INVENTORY" || exit 1
echo '[GNUPG:] VALIDSIG F26C7F594DFE84D131703AFC23E5A318AE8D2861'
TOOL
chmod +x "$scratch/verifier-tools/gpg"

fail() {
    echo "FAIL: $*" >&2
    exit 1
}

# Every archive the installer offers has its checksum embedded, and it is the
# one cargo-dist wrote beside that archive.
arms=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"\(hennery-.*\.tar\.xz\)")$/\1/p' "$installer")
[ -n "$arms" ] || fail "the installer offers no archive"
count=0
for archive in $arms; do
    [ -f "$dist/$archive" ] || fail "the installer offers $archive, and this build has no $archive"
    sum="$dist/$archive.sha256"
    [ -f "$sum" ] || fail "the installer offers $archive, and this build has no $archive.sha256"
    want=$(cut -d ' ' -f 1 "$sum")
    case "$want" in
    *[!0-9a-f]* | "") fail "$sum holds no SHA-256" ;;
    esac
    [ "${#want}" = 64 ] || fail "$sum holds no SHA-256"
    # The installer's case for this archive, up to its `;;`.
    arm=$(awk -v name="\"$archive\")" '$1 == name { on = 1 } on { print } on && $1 == ";;" { exit }' "$installer")
    printf '%s\n' "$arm" | grep -qx '[[:space:]]*_checksum_style="sha256"' ||
        fail "the installer has no sha256 checksum for $archive"
    printf '%s\n' "$arm" | grep -qx "[[:space:]]*_checksum_value=\"$want\"" ||
        fail "the installer's checksum for $archive is not the archive's"
    count=$((count + 1))
done
built=0
for archive in "$dist"/*.tar.xz; do
    [ -f "$archive" ] || continue
    case "${archive##*/}" in
        hennery-*-unknown-linux-musl.tar.xz | hennery-*-apple-darwin.tar.xz) ;;
        *) continue ;;
    esac
    printf '%s\n' "$arms" | grep -Fxq "${archive##*/}" ||
        fail "the installer does not offer ${archive##*/}"
    built=$((built + 1))
done
[ "$count" = "$built" ] || fail "the installer offers $count archives, this build made $built"
echo "ok: the installer embeds each of its $count archives' SHA-256"

# Model the maintainer-approved inventory independently of the installer's
# embedded checksum, including source archives that must never be installed.
command -v jq >/dev/null || fail 'jq is required for inventory fixtures'
ln -s "$(command -v jq)" "$scratch/verifier-tools/jq"
printf '[]' > "$scratch/artifacts.json"
for archive in $arms; do
    want=$(cut -d ' ' -f 1 "$dist/$archive.sha256")
    jq --arg name "$archive" --arg sha "$want" '. + [{name: $name, sha256: $sha}]' "$scratch/artifacts.json" > "$scratch/next.json"
    mv "$scratch/next.json" "$scratch/artifacts.json"
done
jq --arg tag "v$fixture_version" '{schema: 1, repository: "marcinwadon/hennery", tag: $tag, artifacts: .}' "$scratch/artifacts.json" > "$scratch/inventory.json"
cp "$scratch/inventory.json" "$scratch/inventory.json.asc"

# run_installer <download dir> <install dir> <log>: the installer's exit status.
run_installer() {
    mkdir -p "$scratch/home"
    status=0
    PATH="${VERIFIER_TOOLS:-$scratch/verifier-tools}:$PATH" \
        HOME="$scratch/home" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$scratch/home/.config" \
        HENNERY_ATTESTATION_BUNDLE="$scratch/bundle.jsonl" \
        HENNERY_RELEASE_INVENTORY="${TEST_INVENTORY:-$scratch/inventory.json}" \
        HENNERY_RELEASE_SIGNATURE="${TEST_SIGNATURE:-$scratch/inventory.json.asc}" \
        HENNERY_DOWNLOAD_URL="file://$1" HENNERY_UNMANAGED_INSTALL="$2" \
        sh "$1/hennery-installer.sh" >"$3" 2>&1 || status=$?
    return "$status"
}

# refused <name> <download dir> <message>: the installer, run on <download
# dir>, fails with <message> and leaves no binary.
refused() {
    if run_installer "$2" "$scratch/$1" "$scratch/$1.log"; then
        cat "$scratch/$1.log"
        fail "$1: installed"
    fi
    grep -q "$3" "$scratch/$1.log" || {
        cat "$scratch/$1.log"
        fail "$1: failed for another reason"
    }
    [ ! -e "$scratch/$1/hennery" ] || fail "$1: left a binary"
}

# tools <dir> <excluded>...: every command of /usr/bin and /bin but these.
link_tool() {
    _link_source=$1
    _link_destination=$2
    if [ -e "$_link_destination" ] || [ -L "$_link_destination" ]; then
        [ -L "$_link_destination" ] && [ "$_link_destination" -ef "$_link_source" ] ||
            fail "conflicting tool link: $_link_destination"
    else
        ln -s "$_link_source" "$_link_destination" || fail "cannot link tool: $_link_destination"
    fi
}

tools() {
    dir=$1
    shift
    mkdir "$dir"
    for from in /usr/bin /bin; do
        for tool in "$from"/*; do
            name=$(basename "$tool")
            for excluded in "$@"; do
                [ "$name" = "$excluded" ] && continue 2
            done
            link_tool "$tool" "$dir/$name"
        done
    done
}

# copy <name>: a download directory with the installer and the archives.
copy() {
    mkdir "$scratch/$1"
    cp "$installer" "$dist"/*.tar.xz "$scratch/$1/"
    echo "$scratch/$1"
}

UNCHECKED="refusing to install an archive whose checksum cannot be checked"

# A good install.
run_installer "$dist" "$scratch/good" "$scratch/good.log" || {
    cat "$scratch/good.log"
    fail "the installer failed on its own archives"
}
"$scratch/good/hennery" --version || fail "the installed binary does not run"
[ -f "$scratch/signature-verified" ] || fail 'installer never authenticated release provenance'
echo "ok: installs a binary that runs"

# With `shasum` and no `sha256sum`.
tools "$scratch/shasum-tools" sha256sum
# In a subshell: an assignment before a function call may outlive it.
(PATH="$scratch/shasum-tools" && run_installer "$dist" "$scratch/shasum" "$scratch/shasum.log") || {
    cat "$scratch/shasum.log"
    fail "the installer failed with shasum alone"
}
"$scratch/shasum/hennery" --version >/dev/null || fail "the binary installed with shasum does not run"
echo "ok: installs with shasum alone"

# A checksum mismatch: the same archives, one byte longer each.
tampered=$(copy tampered-download)
for archive in "$tampered"/*.tar.xz; do
    printf 'x' >>"$archive"
done
refused tampered "$tampered" "checksum mismatch"
echo "ok: a checksum mismatch aborts"

# No SHA-256 tool at all.
tools "$scratch/no-tools" sha256sum shasum
(PATH="$scratch/no-tools" && refused unchecked "$dist" "$UNCHECKED")
echo "ok: no SHA-256 tool aborts"

# An empty checksum.
empty=$(copy empty-download)
sed 's/^\([[:space:]]*_checksum_value=\)".*"$/\1""/' "$installer" >"$empty/hennery-installer.sh"
refused empty "$empty" "$UNCHECKED"
echo "ok: an empty checksum aborts"

# No checksum at all.
none=$(copy none-download)
grep -v '^[[:space:]]*_checksum_style=' "$installer" >"$none/hennery-installer.sh"
refused none "$none" "$UNCHECKED"
echo "ok: no checksum aborts"

# A checksum style the installer does not know.
unknown=$(copy unknown-download)
sed 's/^\([[:space:]]*_checksum_style=\)"sha256"$/\1"md5"/' "$installer" >"$unknown/hennery-installer.sh"
refused unknown "$unknown" "$UNCHECKED"
echo "ok: an unknown checksum style aborts"

# Existing installs are explicit operator choices. Never replace any of them.
mkdir -p "$scratch/existing" "$scratch/link" "$scratch/dangling" "$scratch/directory/hennery"
printf 'owned by another package manager\n' > "$scratch/existing/hennery"
cp "$scratch/existing/hennery" "$scratch/sentinel"
ln -s "$scratch/sentinel" "$scratch/link/hennery"
ln -s "$scratch/absent-target" "$scratch/dangling/hennery"
for kind in existing link dangling directory; do
    if run_installer "$dist" "$scratch/$kind" "$scratch/$kind.log"; then
        fail "$kind: replaced an existing installation"
    fi
    grep -q 'refusing to overwrite' "$scratch/$kind.log" || fail "$kind: wrong refusal"
done
cmp "$scratch/existing/hennery" "$scratch/sentinel" || fail 'existing install changed'
[ -L "$scratch/link/hennery" ] || fail 'package-manager symlink changed'
[ -L "$scratch/dangling/hennery" ] || fail 'dangling symlink changed'
[ -d "$scratch/directory/hennery" ] || fail 'directory changed'
echo 'ok: existing files, symlinks and directories survive'

# Missing download: no destination is published.
missing=$(copy missing-download)
for archive in "$missing"/*.tar.xz; do
    rm "$archive"
done
if run_installer "$missing" "$scratch/missing" "$scratch/missing.log"; then
    fail 'missing download installed'
fi
[ ! -e "$scratch/missing/hennery" ] || fail 'missing download left a binary'
echo 'ok: failed download leaves no binary'

# Known non-SHA256 algorithms and malformed values must not enter skip paths.
sha512=$(copy sha512-download)
sed 's/^\([[:space:]]*_checksum_style=\)"sha256"$/\1"sha512"/' "$installer" > "$sha512/hennery-installer.sh"
refused sha512 "$sha512" "$UNCHECKED"
malformed=$(copy malformed-download)
sed 's/^\([[:space:]]*_checksum_value=\)".*"$/\1"not-a-digest"/' "$installer" > "$malformed/hennery-installer.sh"
refused malformed "$malformed" "$UNCHECKED"
echo 'ok: non-SHA256 and malformed digest abort'

# Copy and chmod fail before the executable becomes visible. The installer
# uses a private sibling directory, then an exclusive hard link into install dir.
for command in cp chmod ln; do
    tool_dir="$scratch/failing-$command-tools"
    tools "$tool_dir" "$command"
    cat > "$tool_dir/$command" <<'TOOL'
#!/bin/sh
exit 1
TOOL
    chmod +x "$tool_dir/$command"
    (PATH="$tool_dir" && ! run_installer "$dist" "$scratch/failing-$command" "$scratch/failing-$command.log") ||
        fail "$command failure installed"
    [ ! -e "$scratch/failing-$command/hennery" ] || fail "$command failure published an executable"
done
echo 'ok: copy, chmod and publication failures leave no executable'

# Unsupported OS and CPU each refuse before installation.
real_uname=$(command -v uname)
for kind in os cpu; do
    tool_dir="$scratch/unsupported-$kind-tools"
    tools "$tool_dir" uname
    cat > "$tool_dir/uname" <<TOOL
#!/bin/sh
if [ '$kind' = os ]; then echo UnsupportedOS; exit 0; fi
if [ "\${1:-}" = -m ]; then echo unsupported-cpu; exit 0; fi
exec '$real_uname' "\$@"
TOOL
    chmod +x "$tool_dir/uname"
    (PATH="$tool_dir" && ! run_installer "$dist" "$scratch/unsupported-$kind" "$scratch/unsupported-$kind.log") ||
        fail "unsupported $kind installed"
    [ ! -e "$scratch/unsupported-$kind/hennery" ] || fail "unsupported $kind left a binary"
done
echo 'ok: unsupported OS and CPU abort'

# The copy runs while the final pathname is absent, and a destination raced
# into existence after the initial check is never replaced.
real_cp=$(command -v cp)
real_ln=$(command -v ln)
tools "$scratch/observe-copy-tools" cp
cat > "$scratch/observe-copy-tools/cp" <<TOOL
#!/bin/sh
[ ! -e "\$HENNERY_UNMANAGED_INSTALL/hennery" ] || exit 1
printf observed > '$scratch/copy-observed'
exec '$real_cp' "\$@"
TOOL
chmod +x "$scratch/observe-copy-tools/cp"
(PATH="$scratch/observe-copy-tools" && run_installer "$dist" "$scratch/observe-copy" "$scratch/observe-copy.log") || fail 'staged copy failed'
[ -f "$scratch/copy-observed" ] || fail 'the installer did not stage the copy'
tools "$scratch/raced-tools" ln
cat > "$scratch/raced-tools/ln" <<TOOL
#!/bin/sh
printf raced > "\$HENNERY_UNMANAGED_INSTALL/hennery"
exec '$real_ln' "\$@"
TOOL
chmod +x "$scratch/raced-tools/ln"
(PATH="$scratch/raced-tools" && ! run_installer "$dist" "$scratch/raced" "$scratch/raced.log") || fail 'concurrent destination was replaced'
[ "$(cat "$scratch/raced/hennery")" = raced ] || fail 'concurrent destination changed'
echo 'ok: staging is invisible and concurrent destinations survive'

# Even a successful exact-tag attestation cannot replace the touch-approved
# inventory signature. Test-only signer doubles never touch a real GPG key.
for kind in unsigned malformed wrong-key; do
    (export HENNERY_TEST_MAINTAINER_SIGNATURE="$kind"; refused "maintainer-$kind" "$dist" 'maintainer')
done
echo 'ok: unsigned tag, malformed signature and another signing key abort'
(TEST_SIGNATURE="$scratch/missing.asc"; export TEST_SIGNATURE; refused maintainer-missing "$dist" 'missing maintainer')
echo 'ok: missing maintainer signature aborts'
printf ' ' >> "$scratch/inventory.json"
refused maintainer-other-inventory "$dist" 'invalid maintainer release signature'
cp "$scratch/inventory.json.asc" "$scratch/inventory.json"
echo 'ok: signature over another inventory aborts'
jq '.artifacts |= map(.sha256 = ("0" * 64))' "$scratch/inventory.json" > "$scratch/other-inventory.json"
(TEST_INVENTORY="$scratch/other-inventory.json"; TEST_SIGNATURE="$scratch/other-inventory.json"; export TEST_INVENTORY TEST_SIGNATURE; refused maintainer-other-digest "$dist" 'archive differs from maintainer-approved inventory')
echo 'ok: signed inventory must approve the exact archive bytes'

(export HENNERY_TEST_SIGNER_REF=refs/heads/main; refused branch-signer "$dist" 'refusing an archive without valid release-tag provenance')
echo 'ok: branch signer identity cannot authorize installation'
tools "$scratch/no-gh-tools" gh gpg jq
link_tool "$scratch/verifier-tools/gpg" "$scratch/no-gh-tools/gpg"
link_tool "$scratch/verifier-tools/jq" "$scratch/no-gh-tools/jq"
(PATH="$scratch/no-gh-tools" VERIFIER_TOOLS="$scratch/no-gh-tools" && refused missing-verifier "$dist" 'GitHub CLI is required')
echo 'ok: missing signature verifier refuses installation'
````

### Step 3: GREEN / verification

Set scratch tool homes first, then run:

```sh
nix develop .#release -c python3 -m unittest discover -s packaging/release -p test_hardener.py
nix develop .#release -c python3 -m unittest discover -s packaging/release -p test_archives.py
nix develop .#release -c python3 -m unittest discover -s packaging/release -p test_installer_archives.py
```

### Step 4: COPY probe / staged bytes / commit

Use the copied-tree harness below; every counted mutation must fail an actual assertion, without ERROR/KeyError. Compare staged blobs to the tested working bytes and inspect the stat/diff before an unsigned Conventional Commit. No external publication/settings action. The final push uses the exact parent-authorized lease.


## Task 4: Native candidate, protected tagged publication and immutable recovery

### Step 1: RED / contract

The old publisher is RED on reconcile then upload (FileExistsError) and on publishing before assets are attached. Require verified bundle reuse, draft-only upload and immutable publication. Workflow regressions reject branch publication/admin policy tokens and require tag verification before storage. Static lint supplements platform enforcement only. The bootstrap tests first fail actual assertions when the named README block is absent. Require the exact guarded block with real disposable signing subkeys and both SHA-256 tools; tampering, wrong pins/signatures and missing signatures must refuse before execution, including under suppressed errexit.

### Step 2: Exact implementation

### File `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

<!-- r1:file task=4 path=.github/workflows/ci.yml sha256=7315404161d58e43bc8b2240e5c73a7c55365bd7f55fa762cf5249c8e40306f1 bytes=9356 mode=644 encoding=utf8 -->
````yaml
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  # A pull request's superseded run is cancelled. Outside pull requests
  # (pushes to main, manual runs) every commit is a group of its own: a
  # shared group would let a newer pending run replace an older one even
  # without cancel-in-progress, so no run there is ever cancelled.
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  # The web UI (plan 4b): its types, unit tests and build, then the browser
  # checks against the binary it is embedded in. Node, pnpm, the Rust
  # toolchain and Chromium all come from the flake's dev shell.
  web:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      HENNERY_WEB_REQUIRE: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31.11.1
        with:
          github_access_token: ${{ github.token }}
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2.9.2
        with:
          key: web
      - name: Install
        run: nix develop -c pnpm --dir web install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Types
        run: nix develop -c pnpm --dir web typecheck
      - name: Unit tests
        run: nix develop -c pnpm --dir web test
      - name: Build
        run: nix develop -c pnpm --dir web build
      - name: The binary, with the UI embedded, and the fake agent
        run: nix develop -c cargo build -p hennery -p hennery-testkit --bins --locked
      - name: Browser checks
        run: nix develop -c pnpm --dir web e2e
        env:
          CI: "1"

  # The README's quickstart (plan 4f): its clone and build blocks, run as
  # written, by name (`packaging/readme-blocks.sh`). The rest of its blocks
  # run in `crates/hennery/tests/readme.rs`, which checks every name has a
  # runner. No job-wide HENNERY_WEB_REQUIRE: the build block sets it itself.
  readme:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31.11.1
        with:
          github_access_token: ${{ github.token }}
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2.9.2
        with:
          key: readme
      # The clone is of `main`, not of this change: it checks the address
      # and the directory, and the build below runs on this checkout.
      - name: The README's clone block
        run: |
          sh packaging/readme-blocks.sh README.md clone > "$RUNNER_TEMP/clone.sh"
          scratch=$(mktemp -d)
          (cd "$scratch" && sh -eux "$RUNNER_TEMP/clone.sh" && test -f hennery/Cargo.toml)
          rm -rf "$scratch"
      # Its last line puts the binary on PATH, for the checks after it.
      - name: The README's build block
        run: |
          sh packaging/readme-blocks.sh README.md build > "$RUNNER_TEMP/build.sh"
          cat >> "$RUNNER_TEMP/build.sh" <<'SH'
          sh packaging/check-web-ui.sh "$(command -v hennery)"
          SH
          sh -eux "$RUNNER_TEMP/build.sh"

  # The alternative README build: no Nix, no global pnpm install and no
  # system OpenSSL. Run the documented block on both supported OSes.
  readme-without-nix:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@02cb101ec7c40f2c49e1d9714d64511d8e1b74de # master @ 2026-09-12
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2.9.2
        with:
          key: readme-without-nix
      - name: Vendored OpenSSL build tools (ubuntu)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential perl
      - name: Vendored OpenSSL build tools (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: xcode-select -p && cc --version && make --version && perl -v
      # Run the UI check in the same shell as the block's PATH export.
      - name: The README's build without Nix block
        run: |
          sh packaging/readme-blocks.sh README.md build-without-nix > "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-without-nix.sh"
          cat >> "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-without-nix.sh" <<'CHECK'
          sh packaging/check-web-ui.sh "$(command -v hennery)"
          CHECK
          sh -eux "$RUNNER_TEMP/build-without-nix.sh"

  rust:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    # Every build here embeds the real UI, built first (plan 4b): the
    # kernel's build script fails without it.
    env:
      HENNERY_WEB_REQUIRE: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@02cb101ec7c40f2c49e1d9714d64511d8e1b74de # master @ 2026-09-12
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: clippy, rustfmt
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2.9.2
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31.11.1
        with:
          github_access_token: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: The web UI
        run: nix develop .#web -c sh -c 'pnpm --dir web install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir web build'
      # `webauthn-rs` links OpenSSL (plan 3c): the system's for these checks.
      # Release builds build their own (`vendored-openssl`, build.yml).
      - name: OpenSSL headers (ubuntu)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev pkg-config
      # Named rather than left to the image (plan 7a): installed if a future
      # image lacks it, and pointed at, so no other OpenSSL is picked up.
      - name: OpenSSL (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew list openssl@3 > /dev/null 2>&1 || brew install openssl@3
          echo "OPENSSL_DIR=$(brew --prefix openssl@3)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      # `hennery service install` captures the login shell's PATH; its tests
      # run bash, zsh and fish (plan 7c), and must not skip here.
      - name: Login shells (ubuntu)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get install -y zsh fish
      - run: cargo fmt --all --check
      - run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
      - name: Clippy on the shipped binary (test-hooks off)
        run: cargo clippy -p hennery --locked -- -D warnings
      # On Linux the tests run with no network but loopback: built first,
      # while the network is there, then run in a network namespace of their
      # own whose only link is `lo`. A test that reaches a registry, or any
      # host but 127.0.0.1 and ::1, fails here instead of passing on whatever
      # answers (plan 7b's review found one that reached npm). They run as the
      # runner's own user again (`setpriv`), so permission checks still bite,
      # with the environment kept and the hard RLIMIT_NOFILE raised past the
      # adapter's closing loop's cap (`MAX_CLOSED_FD`, 65536, the runner's own
      # hard limit), so the test of `close_range` can hold a descriptor past
      # it (it asserts it ran, under `CI`).
      # macOS has no network namespaces (`sandbox-exec` is deprecated), so its
      # tests run with the network: ubuntu is where a leak is caught.
      - name: Real proxy binaries for the deployment gate
        run: |
          nix develop -c sh >> "$GITHUB_PATH" <<'SH'
          dirname "$(command -v caddy)"
          dirname "$(command -v nginx)"
          SH
      - name: Tests
        run: |
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" != Linux ]; then
            cargo test --workspace --locked
            exit 0
          fi
          cargo test --workspace --locked --no-run
          sudo --preserve-env env "PATH=$PATH" "HOME=$HOME" unshare --net -- sh -c '
            ip link set lo up
            exec prlimit --nofile=65536:1048576 -- setpriv --reuid="$SUDO_UID" --regid="$SUDO_GID" --init-groups -- cargo test --workspace --locked --offline
          '
        env:
          # On ubuntu the PATH-capture and unit-lint tests fail rather than
          # skip when a shell or `systemd-analyze` is missing.
          HENNERY_REQUIRE_SHELLS: ${{ runner.os == 'Linux' && 'bash,zsh,fish' || '' }}
          HENNERY_REQUIRE_SYSTEMD_ANALYZE: ${{ runner.os == 'Linux' && '1' || '' }}
      - name: Generated files are up to date
        run: cargo run -p hennery-proto --bin gen --locked -- --check
      - name: Generated view types are up to date
        run: cargo run -p hennery-view --bin gen-view --locked -- --check
````

### File `.github/workflows/nix.yml`

<!-- r1:file task=4 path=.github/workflows/nix.yml sha256=928d49b2a1205e369130621fb89695f0b2a757ef4978092d0bc982b99a69859e bytes=2006 mode=644 encoding=utf8 -->
````yaml
# The Nix flake (distribution spec §4.3, §9; plan 7e-i): `nix flake check`
# builds the package and runs clippy, rustfmt and cargo-audit through crane,
# on Linux and on macOS, and the package's binary runs. Nothing is pushed to
# a binary cache: that would publish. The tests stay `ci.yml`'s.
#
# The Nix installer is pinned by commit. The job's own read-only token goes
# to Nix only to fetch the locked GitHub inputs without hitting the
# anonymous API rate limit that shared runners share.
name: nix

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  # A pull request's superseded run is cancelled. Outside pull requests
  # (pushes to main, manual runs) every commit is a group of its own: a
  # shared group would let a newer pending run replace an older one even
  # without cancel-in-progress, so no run there is ever cancelled.
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  flake:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-15]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    # A cold build takes about 9 minutes; a hung one should not run for hours.
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31.11.1
        with:
          github_access_token: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Flake checks (package, clippy, rustfmt, cargo-audit)
        run: nix flake check -L
      - name: The package runs
        run: nix run . -- --version
      # The README's nix block (plan 4f), run as written.
      - name: The README's nix block
        run: |
          sh packaging/readme-blocks.sh README.md nix > "$RUNNER_TEMP/nix.sh"
          sh -eux "$RUNNER_TEMP/nix.sh"
````

<!-- r1:file task=4 path=.github/workflows/release-candidate.yml sha256=9528a9a1750f8d8acdcbb30c7c7e287f5b023c2e5b1a150a611519153234e69b bytes=12928 mode=644 encoding=utf8 -->
````yaml
name: release-candidate
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: Annotated approved release tag; candidate creation only
        required: true
        type: string
      channels:
        description: Comma-separated channels; first alpha is github only
        default: github
        required: true
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: release-candidate-${{ github.event.inputs.tag || github.ref }}-${{ github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  tag-signature:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31.11.1
      - name: Verify pinned maintainer signature and exact candidate SHA before storage credentials
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.inputs.tag || github.ref_name }}
        run: nix develop .#release -c python3 packaging/release/tag_signature.py --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --source-sha "$GITHUB_SHA"
  web-ui:
    needs: tag-signature
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.tag || github.ref }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31.11.1
        with:
          github_access_token: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Build the UI once from the pinned lock
        run: nix develop .#web -c sh -c 'pnpm --dir web install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir web build'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: release-ui
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: web/dist/
  archive:
    needs: web-ui
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            image: amd64
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            image: arm64
          - target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            runner: macos-15
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.tag || github.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Annotated tag, exact source and workspace version
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.inputs.tag || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          test "$(git cat-file -t "$RELEASE_TAG")" = tag
          source_sha=$(git rev-parse "$RELEASE_TAG^{commit}")
          test "$source_sha" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          echo "RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA=$source_sha" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          python3 -c 'import os,tomllib; from pathlib import Path; v=tomllib.loads(Path("Cargo.toml").read_text())["workspace"]["package"]["version"]; assert os.environ["RELEASE_TAG"] == "v"+v'
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@02cb101ec7c40f2c49e1d9714d64511d8e1b74de # master @ 2026-09-12
        with:
          toolchain: 1.98.1
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31.11.1
        with:
          github_access_token: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Native build tools
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y musl-tools
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: release-ui
          path: web/dist/
      - name: Pinned dist and source and licence inputs
        run: |
          sh packaging/install-dist.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist-bin"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          nix develop .#web -c sh -c 'pnpm --dir web install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir web licenses list --json > frontend-licences.json'
          cargo metadata --locked --all-features --filter-platform '${{ matrix.target }}' --format-version=1 > cargo-metadata.json
          nix develop .#release -c python3 packaging/release/supply.py materials --output release-materials \
            --source-sha "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" --target '${{ matrix.target }}' \
            --cargo-metadata cargo-metadata.json --frontend-licences frontend-licences.json
      - name: Current advisory databases; findings stop candidate creation
        run: |
          nix develop .#release -c cargo-audit audit --file Cargo.lock --db "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-advisories" --json > release-materials/rust-advisories.json
          git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-advisories" rev-parse HEAD > release-materials/rust-advisory-revision.txt
          nix develop .#web -c pnpm --dir web audit --json > release-materials/web-advisories.json
      - name: Build fresh final archive with notices
        env:
          HENNERY_WEB_REQUIRE: '1'
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          import json
          i=json.load(open('release-materials/build-identity.json'))
          for key, field in [('HENNERY_BUILD_SOURCE_SHA','source_sha'),('HENNERY_BUILD_UI_SHA256','ui_sha256'),('HENNERY_BUILD_MANIFEST_SHA256','adapter_manifest_sha256')]:
              print(key+'='+i[field])
          PY
      - name: Archive and content acceptance
        env:
          HENNERY_WEB_REQUIRE: '1'
        run: |
          dist build --artifacts=local --target='${{ matrix.target }}' --print=linkage --output-format=json > target-manifest.json
          archive='hennery-${{ matrix.target }}'
          mkdir -p unpacked
          tar -xJf "target/distrib/$archive.tar.xz" -C unpacked
          cp release-materials/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt "unpacked/$archive/"
          tar -cJf "target/distrib/$archive.tar.xz" -C unpacked "$archive"
          (cd target/distrib && shasum -a 256 "$archive.tar.xz" > "$archive.tar.xz.sha256")
          sh packaging/check-archive.sh "target/distrib/$archive.tar.xz" '${{ matrix.target }}' --notices
          binary="$PWD/unpacked/$archive/hennery"
          sh packaging/check-linkage.sh "$binary"
          sh packaging/check-web-ui.sh "$binary"
          "$binary" --version
          cp target-manifest.json 'target/distrib/${{ matrix.target }}-dist-manifest.json'
          python3 packaging/release/refresh_manifest.py 'target/distrib/${{ matrix.target }}-dist-manifest.json' "target/distrib/$archive.tar.xz"
          cp release-materials/* target/distrib/
          python3 - <<'PY' > target/distrib/builder.json
          import json,os,platform,subprocess
          print(json.dumps({'os':platform.platform(),'runner_image':os.environ.get('ImageVersion'),'rust':subprocess.check_output(['rustc','-vV'],text=True),'sdk':subprocess.getoutput('xcrun --show-sdk-version') if platform.system()=='Darwin' else subprocess.getoutput('ldd --version')}))
          PY
      - name: Alpine executable and collector image smoke
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          IMAGE_ARCH: ${{ matrix.image }}
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
        run: |
          binary="$PWD/unpacked/hennery-$TARGET/hennery"
          docker run --rm -v "$binary:/hennery:ro" alpine:3@sha256:294b683cb724975bec92580e1e685676bd4b50bda910ddb8c51d4cabeaec77e6 /hennery --version
          mkdir -p "dist/linux-$IMAGE_ARCH"
          cp "$binary" "dist/linux-$IMAGE_ARCH/hennery"
          docker build -t hennery-collector:candidate .
          sh packaging/smoke-image.sh hennery-collector:candidate
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: candidate-${{ matrix.target }}
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: target/distrib/
  assemble:
    needs: archive
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.tag || github.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          pattern: candidate-*
          path: candidates
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31.11.1
        with:
          github_access_token: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Assemble global inputs; never silently merge conflicting materials
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.inputs.tag || github.ref_name }}
          RELEASE_CHANNELS: ${{ github.event.inputs.channels || 'github' }}
        run: |
          sh packaging/install-dist.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist-bin"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          python3 packaging/release/assemble.py candidates target/distrib
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist-bin/dist" build --artifacts=global --output-format=json > target/distrib/dist-manifest.json
          python3 packaging/harden-installer.py target/distrib/hennery-installer.sh
          sh packaging/test-installer.sh target/distrib
          sh packaging/check-formula.sh target/distrib
          git show HEAD:CHANGELOG.md > target/distrib/release-notes.md
          git archive --format=tar --prefix=hennery-source/ HEAD | xz > target/distrib/hennery-source.tar.xz
          python3 packaging/release/supply.py freeze --output target/distrib \
            --source-sha "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --channels "$RELEASE_CHANNELS" \
            --run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --run-attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" > inventory-sha256.txt
          cat inventory-sha256.txt >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo 'Candidate still needs Object Lock retention and channel acceptance before approval.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: frozen-candidate-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: target/distrib/
  installer:
    needs: assemble
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-15]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.tag || github.ref }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: frozen-candidate-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: candidate
      - name: Native installer positives and refusals
        run: sh packaging/test-installer.sh candidate
  retain:
    needs: [assemble, installer, tag-signature]
    if: vars.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_STORAGE_ENABLED == 'true'
    environment: release-staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.tag || github.ref }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31.11.1
        with:
          github_access_token: ${{ github.token }}
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: frozen-candidate-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: candidate
      - name: Retain exact versions under compliance retention and legal hold
        env:
          RELEASE_BUCKET: ${{ vars.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_BUCKET }}
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_STAGE_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_STAGE_KEY }}
          AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: ${{ vars.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_REGION }}
        run: |
          inventory=$(sha256sum candidate/release-inventory.json | cut -d' ' -f1)
          nix develop .#release -c python3 packaging/release/retention.py stage \
            --candidate candidate --bucket "$RELEASE_BUCKET" --inventory-sha256 "$inventory" --receipt retention-receipt.json
          echo "Held candidate inventory: $inventory" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: retention-receipt-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: retention-receipt.json
````

### File `.github/workflows/release-publish.yml`

<!-- r1:file task=4 path=.github/workflows/release-publish.yml sha256=6edc52bcb1588e4fe5dee45da61f7249718bdd884f53f298f38f917eed57b9ad bytes=13174 mode=644 encoding=utf8 -->
````yaml
name: release-publish
run-name: Release inventory ${{ inputs.inventory_sha256 }} from ${{ inputs.tag }}
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      inventory_sha256:
        description: Frozen candidate inventory SHA-256
        required: true
        type: string
      maintainer_signature:
        description: Armored hardware-backed detached signature over the exact frozen inventory
        required: true
        type: string
      settings_audit_sha256:
        description: SHA-256 of the maintainer local settings audit
        required: true
        type: string
      settings_audit:
        description: Canonical maintainer audit JSON, fresh for this completed candidate
        required: true
        type: string
      source_sha:
        description: Exact qualified source commit
        required: true
        type: string
      tag:
        description: Protected annotated release tag
        required: true
        type: string
      channels:
        description: Approved sorted JSON channel array
        required: true
        type: string
      targets:
        description: Approved sorted JSON target array
        required: true
        type: string
      candidate:
        description: JSON candidate run_id and run_attempt
        required: true
        type: string
      retention_receipt_version:
        description: Exact S3 version of the held retention receipt
        required: true
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: release-publish-${{ inputs.tag }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  approval-tuple:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Display exact approval binding for this run attempt
        run: python3 packaging/release/approval_summary.py
  authorize:
    needs: approval-tuple
    if: vars.RELEASE_PUBLICATION_ENABLED == 'true' && github.ref == format('refs/tags/{0}', inputs.tag)
    environment: release
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      RELEASE_AUDIT_BUCKET: ${{ vars.RELEASE_AUDIT_BUCKET }}
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_AUDIT_WRITE_KEY_ID }}
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_AUDIT_WRITE_KEY }}
      AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: ${{ vars.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_REGION }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    outputs:
      run_attempt: ${{ steps.authorized.outputs.run_attempt }}
      inventory_sha256: ${{ steps.authorized.outputs.inventory_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31.11.1
        with:
          github_access_token: ${{ github.token }}
      # AWS read access is restricted to held candidate versions; it conveys
      # no registry/release authority. No write token is given to candidate code.
      - name: Fetch exact held candidate
        env:
          RELEASE_BUCKET: ${{ vars.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_BUCKET }}
          INVENTORY: ${{ inputs.inventory_sha256 }}
          RECEIPT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.retention_receipt_version }}
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_READ_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_READ_KEY }}
          AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: ${{ vars.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_REGION }}
        run: |
          nix develop .#release -c aws s3api get-object --bucket "$RELEASE_BUCKET" --key "candidates/$INVENTORY/retention-receipt.json" --version-id "$RECEIPT_VERSION" retention-receipt.json
          nix develop .#release -c python3 packaging/release/retention.py fetch --candidate candidate --inventory-sha256 "$INVENTORY" --receipt retention-receipt.json
      - uses: ./.github/actions/release-gate
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        with:
          candidate: candidate
          inventory-sha256: ${{ inputs.inventory_sha256 }}
          channel: github
          phase: preflight
          receipt: authorize-preflight.json
      - name: Publish the validated credential-issuance binding
        id: authorized
        env:
          INVENTORY: ${{ inputs.inventory_sha256 }}
        run: |
          echo "run_attempt=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "inventory_sha256=$INVENTORY" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  sign:
    needs: authorize
    if: vars.RELEASE_PUBLICATION_ENABLED == 'true' && github.ref == format('refs/tags/{0}', inputs.tag) && needs.authorize.outputs.run_attempt == github.run_attempt && needs.authorize.outputs.inventory_sha256 == inputs.inventory_sha256
    environment:
      name: release
      url: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      RELEASE_AUDIT_BUCKET: ${{ vars.RELEASE_AUDIT_BUCKET }}
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_AUDIT_WRITE_KEY_ID }}
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_AUDIT_WRITE_KEY }}
      AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: ${{ vars.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_REGION }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31.11.1
        with:
          github_access_token: ${{ github.token }}
      # AWS read access is restricted to held candidate versions; it conveys
      # no registry/release authority. No write token is given to candidate code.
      - name: Fetch exact held candidate
        env:
          RELEASE_BUCKET: ${{ vars.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_BUCKET }}
          INVENTORY: ${{ inputs.inventory_sha256 }}
          RECEIPT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.retention_receipt_version }}
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_READ_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_READ_KEY }}
          AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: ${{ vars.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_REGION }}
        run: |
          nix develop .#release -c aws s3api get-object --bucket "$RELEASE_BUCKET" --key "candidates/$INVENTORY/retention-receipt.json" --version-id "$RECEIPT_VERSION" retention-receipt.json
          nix develop .#release -c python3 packaging/release/retention.py fetch --candidate candidate --inventory-sha256 "$INVENTORY" --receipt retention-receipt.json
      - uses: ./.github/actions/release-gate
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        with:
          candidate: candidate
          inventory-sha256: ${{ inputs.inventory_sha256 }}
          channel: github
          phase: preflight
          receipt: sign-preflight.json
      - uses: ./.github/actions/release-gate
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        with:
          candidate: candidate
          inventory-sha256: ${{ inputs.inventory_sha256 }}
          channel: github
          phase: boundary
          receipt: sign-boundary.json
      - name: Attest final bytes, including signed inventory and SPDX files
        id: attest
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@e8998f949152b193b063cb0ec769d69d929409be # v2.4.0
        with:
          subject-path: candidate/*
      - name: Preserve downloadable Sigstore bundle and approval receipts
        run: |
          mkdir signatures
          python3 - <<'PYAPPROVAL'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          Path('signatures/release-inventory.json.asc').write_text(json.loads(Path(os.environ['GITHUB_EVENT_PATH']).read_text())['inputs']['maintainer_signature'])
          PYAPPROVAL
          cp '${{ steps.attest.outputs.bundle-path }}' signatures/release.sigstore.jsonl
          cp sign-preflight.json sign-boundary.json retention-receipt.json signatures/
          nix develop .#release -c python3 - <<'PY'
          import os,sys
          from pathlib import Path
          sys.path.insert(0,'packaging/release')
          import retention
          retention.audit(Path('signatures/release-inventory.json.asc'), os.environ['RELEASE_AUDIT_BUCKET'], int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID']), int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']))
          retention.audit(Path('signatures/release.sigstore.jsonl'), os.environ['RELEASE_AUDIT_BUCKET'], int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID']), int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']))
          PY
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: signatures-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: signatures/
  github:
    needs: [sign, authorize]
    if: vars.RELEASE_PUBLICATION_ENABLED == 'true' && github.ref == format('refs/tags/{0}', inputs.tag) && needs.authorize.outputs.run_attempt == github.run_attempt && needs.authorize.outputs.inventory_sha256 == inputs.inventory_sha256 && vars.RELEASE_GITHUB_ENABLED == 'true'
    environment: release
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      RELEASE_AUDIT_BUCKET: ${{ vars.RELEASE_AUDIT_BUCKET }}
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_AUDIT_WRITE_KEY_ID }}
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_AUDIT_WRITE_KEY }}
      AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: ${{ vars.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_REGION }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@13d8dd58da0234aa297dedd986986ccb8e7f3e24 # v31.11.1
        with:
          github_access_token: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Fetch exact held candidate
        env:
          RELEASE_BUCKET: ${{ vars.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_BUCKET }}
          INVENTORY: ${{ inputs.inventory_sha256 }}
          RECEIPT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.retention_receipt_version }}
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_READ_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_READ_KEY }}
          AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: ${{ vars.RELEASE_CANDIDATE_REGION }}
        run: |
          nix develop .#release -c aws s3api get-object --bucket "$RELEASE_BUCKET" --key "candidates/$INVENTORY/retention-receipt.json" --version-id "$RECEIPT_VERSION" retention-receipt.json
          nix develop .#release -c python3 packaging/release/retention.py fetch --candidate candidate --inventory-sha256 "$INVENTORY" --receipt retention-receipt.json
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: signatures-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: signatures
      - uses: ./.github/actions/release-gate
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        with:
          candidate: candidate
          inventory-sha256: ${{ inputs.inventory_sha256 }}
          channel: github
          phase: preflight
          receipt: publish-preflight.json
      - name: Reconcile every existing remote byte before any upload
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: nix develop .#release -c python3 packaging/release/publish.py reconcile --candidate candidate --signatures signatures --output reconciliation.json
      - name: Obtain short-lived publication authority after preflight
        id: publication-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@67018539274d69449ef7c02e8e71183d1719ab42 # v2.1.4
        with:
          app-id: ${{ vars.RELEASE_PUBLISH_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PUBLISH_APP_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: hennery
          permission-contents: write
          permission-actions: read
      - uses: ./.github/actions/release-gate
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        with:
          candidate: candidate
          inventory-sha256: ${{ inputs.inventory_sha256 }}
          channel: github
          phase: boundary
          receipt: publish-boundary.json
      - name: Publish only verified missing bytes; verify upload responses by fetch/hash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.publication-token.outputs.token }}
          RELEASE_PUBLICATION_ENABLED: ${{ vars.RELEASE_PUBLICATION_ENABLED }}
        run: nix develop .#release -c python3 packaging/release/publish.py upload --candidate candidate --signatures signatures --output public-path.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        if: always()
        with:
          name: publication-audit-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            publish-preflight.json
            publish-boundary.json
            reconciliation.json
            public-path.json
````
